reuse.why: Adds the check to the existing shared pre-link guard that every link path (directly or via linkBankSyncAccount) already calls.

duplication.why: One check in one function; no per-provider copies.

placement.why: Right shared guard in accounts/app.ts, but the guard keeps the name assertBankAccountNotLinked though it now also asserts the target is open.

scope.why: A single hunk plus tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Covers every link path from one place; the misleading guard name is a small readability cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the existing shared guard.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkEnableBankingAccount and linkBankSyncAccount (which serves Pluggy, Akahu, Fintegra).
